canonical_candidate_title: The Chak of Bangladesh: A Sociolinguistic Study
extent_evidence: Secondary bibliographic citation in Huziwara (2016), p. 23 of the repository PDF; not yet verified against the publisher file.
lexical_evidence: Sangdong (2012), thesis pp. 43-45, states that Tables 5 and 6 extract Maggard (2007) wordlists and that the Sak/Chak material is presented in IPA as transcribed in the source.
Huziwara (2020), article p. 45 n. 5, states that Maggard et al. (2007) provides lexical data for four Cak varieties spoken in Bangladesh.
official_list_title: The Chak of Bangladesh (A Sociolinguistic Survey)

official_locator.strongest_retrievable_official_locator: The SIL Bangladesh survey-report list names the Chak report and embeds a publisher-hosted cover image; the cover visually verifies the exact title, compilers, field researchers and June 2007 date. The official survey-program chart marks Chak as Done. Neither official page exposes a report PDF or archive-record link.

primary_cover_asset.visible_title: The Chak of Bangladesh: A Sociolinguistic Study
primary_cover_asset.scope: Primary cover metadata only. The cover is not the report and cannot establish extent, pagination, wordlist pages or lexical readings.

primary_source_verification.unresolved_coordinates: all publisher report pages, wordlist lists and cells; exact pages are unknown because no publisher PDF or archive record was retrievable

policy: Secondary works establish that lexical data and IPA wordlists exist but cannot supply or verify Jambu forms. Ingestion waits for the publisher report, rendered-page inspection, and cell-by-cell manual transcription; OCR or PDF text may locate material only.

secondary_variety_evidence.reconciliation_status: The four-variety count is explicit, but the complete four-way labels and publisher-table structure remain unverified without the primary report.

acquisition_audit.publisher_listing_result: The exact report label and publisher cover dependency were recovered from the official listing's 2024-11-11 Wayback capture; no attached report file or archive link is exposed.
acquisition_audit.publisher_archive_search_result: No exact Chak archive record or publisher PDF was found by exact-title, author, site-restricted, official asset-prefix, SIL-series, or archive-index searches.

sil_esr_2007_audit.visual_cover_result: All retrievable PDF covers were rendered and inspected; none is the Chak report. Issues 012, 017 and 024 currently replay archive error HTML, but their indexed titles/files are unrelated historical ESR issue slots and no bibliography identifies Chak as an SIL Electronic Survey Report.

acquisition_audit.official_availability_note: SIL Bangladesh states that archive resources not available for download may be available upon request through SIL International Publications.
acquisition_audit.next_action: Send SIL Bangladesh/SIL International Publications the exact primary-cover metadata (The Chak of Bangladesh: A Sociolinguistic Study; compiled by Loren Maggard, Mridul Sangma and Sayed Ahmad; field researchers Mridul Sangma and Sayed Ahmad; June 2007) and request a scan of the complete ix + 56-page report. On receipt, checksum the untouched file, verify the cover and extent, render every page at 300 dpi, locate every wordlist/table visually, and only then freeze a first manual cell-by-cell transcription block.
